label: Ezine
note: Mixed milk, about 40 % goat, 50 % sheep, 10 % cow; no starter; ripened in metal tins like Edirne cheese. First Turkish cheese registered in the EU.

about.text: Ezine is a full-fat Turkish white cheese from the Ezine district of Çanakkale and the Kaz Dağları, soft to medium-hard and ripened in brine. It is one of the most popular white cheeses in Turkey, with PDO status.
